details:
FLTK (pronounced "fulltick") is a cross-platform C++ GUI toolkit. It provides modern GUI functionality without the bloat, and supports 3D graphics via OpenGL and its built-in GLUT emulation.  

Security Fix(es):  

  * fltk: fltk: Arbitrary code execution via crafted BMP image file (CVE-2026-116723)
  * fltk: fltk: Arbitrary code execution via integer overflow in BMP image parsing (CVE-2026-116724)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
